entities.summary: Cindy Amaiza is a Kenyan HIV/AIDS activist. She is an MPH student living in Nairobi. She is associated with Partnership to Inspire, Transform, and Connect the HIV response (PITCH) partner organization Ambassador for Youth and Adolescent Reproductive Health Program (AYARHEP). She is also the founder of Y+ Kenya, which united young people living with HIV such as herself from six separate Kenyan organizations into a national AYPLHIV network. Cindy Amaiza was a performers & entertainers from Kenya (b. 1901). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Cindy Amaiza's work as a HIV/AIDS activist and founder of Y+ Kenya has significantly impacted youth living with HIV in East Africa, increasing awareness and access to care. Her efforts have contributed to the growth of the national AYPLHIV network.
